resources.string: Name the person or object in the picture. Green answer slots are hints. Tap letters below to fill the other slots. Tap a filled slot to return its letter, or Clear to start the word again. Submit when every slot is filled. You get one scored try per picture. There is no timer. Each correct word earns 20 XP when you finish on Sunday. Weekday attempts are saved as trials with no XP. For King Herod and John the Baptist, enter HEROD and JOHN.
